previous_statement: The amplified column-Hilbert defining display, applied to V=Z dot X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, gives Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q and hence 2*<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q=2*Y^dagger dot (Z dot X).
new_statement: Under the exact allowed inputs, the claimed application of the amplified column-Hilbert display to V=Z dot X is unavailable: neither def-ha-map nor def-hcb-datum nor either allowed upstream lemma proves Z dot X lies in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. Consequently one cannot infer Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q, and the stated root variational identity is not derivable (indeed its inner-product term is not typed by the registered data) without an additional allowed corner-product typing result, or an equivalent definition of a target-corner compression of Z dot X.
